findings.title: Metric alert handler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `StatefulDetectorHandler` requires subclasses to implement abstract methods, including `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`. This `pass` subclass implements none of them, so `Detector.detector_handler` raises `TypeError` when processing a detector with this registered handler. The previous handler was concrete and returned an empty result; preserve a concrete no-op handler or implement the required methods.

findings.title: Evaluation docstring still says the method returns a list
findings.body: `evaluate` now returns a dictionary keyed by group key, but this docstring says it returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`. That documents the old contract and can mislead subclasses and callers about the returned shape; update it to describe the dictionary.
